name: Expert_ABE_BE_MFI
summary: This EA uses the MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator smoothed by a Moving Average as a momentum-based signal filter within the MetaQuotes Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It opens and closes positions based on threshold-crossing signals from the CBE_BE_MFI filter, with fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop. The strategy is a single-signal, single-timeframe systematic momentum approach.
summary_zh: 该EA使用MFI（市场促进指数）指标经过移动平均平滑后作为动量信号过滤器，基于MetaQuotes标准库专家顾问框架运行。根据CBE_BE_MFI过滤器的阈值穿越信号开仓和平仓，采用固定手数且无追踪止损。策略为单一信号、单周期的系统性动量方法。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于MFI（市场促进指数）指标的动量判断，通过将MFI值与MA平滑后的MFI值进行比较，识别市场动量的变化方向。入场条件为当CBE_BE_MFI过滤器的综合信号值超过开仓阈值（默认40）时开仓，信号权重默认为1.0。出场条件为当信号值低于平仓阈值（默认20）时平仓，同时支持挂单并在4根K线后过期。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（CMoneyFixedLot），默认手数为0.1，不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理方面，设置了10%的百分比参数，但实际使用固定手数，资金管理相对简单。该策略未设置止损和止盈水平（均为0），也没有追踪止损，完全依赖信号过滤器的阈值判断来决定出入场。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum detection using the MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator, comparing raw MFI values against an MA-smoothed MFI to identify shifts in market momentum direction. Entry conditions trigger when the CBE_BE_MFI filter's composite signal value exceeds the opening threshold (default 40), with a signal weight of 1.0 by default. Exit conditions activate when the signal value falls below the closing threshold (default 20), and the EA also supports pending orders that expire after 4 bars. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default lot size of 0.1, without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management sets a 10% percent parameter but effectively uses fixed lots, making capital management relatively simplistic. The strategy has no stop loss or take profit levels configured (both set to 0), no trailing stop, and relies entirely on the signal filter's threshold logic for trade entries and exits.

parameters.name: Expert_MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: Expert_EveryTick
parameters.description: 是否每个Tick都执行，false表示仅在新K线开盘时执行

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdOpen
parameters.description: 开仓信号阈值（0-100），信号值超过此值才开仓

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdClose
parameters.description: 平仓信号阈值（0-100），信号值低于此值才平仓

parameters.name: Signal_PriceLevel
parameters.description: 执行交易的价位水平，0表示市价执行

parameters.name: Signal_StopLevel
parameters.description: 止损水平（点数），0表示不设止损

parameters.name: Signal_TakeLevel
parameters.description: 止盈水平（点数），0表示不设止盈

pros: 使用MFI指标结合MA平滑，能有效过滤市场噪音，识别真实的动量变化
基于MetaQuotes标准库框架，代码结构清晰，模块化程度高，易于维护和扩展
采用阈值机制控制开平仓，提供了一定的灵活性和参数调优空间
Expert_EveryTick设为false，仅在K线开盘时计算，减少了计算负担和过度交易
pros_en: Uses MFI indicator combined with MA smoothing, effectively filtering market noise and identifying genuine momentum shifts
Built on the MetaQuotes Standard Library framework with clean code structure, high modularity, and easy maintenance and extension
Employs a threshold mechanism for entry/exit control, providing flexibility and parameter optimization space
Expert_EveryTick set to false, calculating only on new bar open, reducing computational load and overtrading
cons: 止损和止盈均设为0，完全没有价格保护机制，在极端行情下可能导致巨大亏损
固定手数资金管理过于简单，不根据账户规模和波动率动态调整仓位
仅依赖单一MFI信号过滤器，缺乏多维度确认，容易产生虚假信号导致的亏损交易
无追踪止损机制，盈利头寸可能因市场回撤而大幅缩水甚至转为亏损
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit both set to 0, offering no price protection whatsoever, which can lead to catastrophic losses during extreme market moves
Fixed lot money management is overly simplistic, failing to dynamically adjust position size based on account size and volatility
Relies on a single MFI signal filter without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to false signals and losing trades
No trailing stop mechanism means profitable positions can give back significant gains or even turn into losses on market retracements
improvements: 增加止损和止盈参数，建议至少设置基于ATR的动态止损，以控制单笔交易最大风险
引入多时间框架确认或其他辅助指标（如趋势过滤器）以减少虚假信号
将固定手数改为动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR波动率计算最优手数
添加追踪止损模块替代当前的TrailingNone，保护浮动盈利
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameters; recommend at least ATR-based dynamic stop loss to control maximum risk per trade
Introduce multi-timeframe confirmation or auxiliary indicators (e.g., trend filter) to reduce false signals
Replace fixed lot sizing with dynamic position management based on account balance and ATR volatility
Add a trailing stop module to replace the current TrailingNone, protecting floating profits

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，交易完全暴露于市场风险中，无任何价格保护
单一信号源缺乏确认机制，容易在震荡市中频繁开平仓造成连续亏损
固定手数不随账户变化调整，在亏损累积后无法自动降低风险敞口
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit are both zero, leaving trades fully exposed to market risk without any price protection
Single signal source lacks confirmation mechanism, prone to frequent entries and exits in choppy markets causing consecutive losses
Fixed lot size does not adjust with account changes, unable to automatically reduce risk exposure after accumulated losses

The strategy is a single-signal, single-timeframe systematic momentum approach.
